lede.en: The Caliburn G4 Pro runs on a touchscreen. Below, one by one, what a tap can do.
lede.zh: Caliburn G4 Pro 用触屏操作。下面逐项看看轻点一下能做什么。

body.en: The core functions sit on the screen itself, so there are no instructions to memorise.
body.zh: 核心功能都在屏幕上，不用再记操作说明。

text.zh: 触控准确率 99.99% 以上（UWELL 实验室数据）
响应时间不到 0.2 秒（UWELL 实验室数据）

subline.en: Half ready to use, half to unlock.
subline.zh: 一半直接可用，一半等你解锁。

body.en: UWELL wants vaping to feel like levelling up: keep using it and the screen has something new to open.
body.zh: UWELL 想让抽烟像打怪升级：一直用下去，屏幕就有新内容可解锁。

text.en: 3 themes from day one, each with its own vaping animation
text.zh: 3 款主题开箱即用，各配专属抽吸动画

text.en: 3 hidden themes open at 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 puffs

body.en: UWELL keeps the rest of the settings in this one menu.
body.zh: UWELL 把其余设置都放在这一个菜单里。

text.zh: 8 种语言（不含泰语）

text.en: Rename the device with Clean UI
text.zh: 开启 Clean UI 可为设备改名

text.en: Brightness, screen timeout, animations, battery saver
text.zh: 亮度、息屏时间、动画、省电模式

subline.en: Storm and Waves are still there.
subline.zh: Storm 和 Waves 依然都在。

body.en: Storm gives an instant throat hit, Waves a smooth flavour. Custom is the one you tune yourself.
body.zh: Storm 带来即时击喉感，Waves 口感顺滑，Custom 由你自己调。

text.en: Set the power at the start, middle and end of each puff
text.zh: 每一口的开头、中段、结尾都能设定功率

subline.en: A bigger battery than the standard G4.
subline.zh: 电池比标准版 G4 更大。

body.en: How long yours lasts depends on how often you vape and the wattage you set.
body.zh: 实际能用几天，取决于抽吸频率和设定的功率。

text.zh: 内置 1800mAh 电池

text.en: Up to 7 days of use (UWELL's figure)
text.zh: 最长使用 7 天（UWELL 数据）
USB-C 充电，5V/2.5A

title.zh: 兼容所有 GPP 烟弹

body.en: The upgraded pods fit the G3 series too, and you refill without taking the pod out.
body.zh: 升级款烟弹也适用于 G3 系列，注油无需取下烟弹。

text.en: Top- and side-refill pods from 0.4Ω to 1.2Ω
text.zh: 顶部与侧边注油烟弹，0.4Ω 至 1.2Ω
U² 防漏
贴合唇形的烟嘴

link.en: See the GPP pods for the G4 Pro

en.heading: G4 Pro or G4 Pro KOKO?
paragraphs: Both have a touchscreen, up to 35W and GPP pods.
The G4 Pro is the slim one, with the bigger 2.51-inch screen, at about 78g.
The [G4 Pro KOKO](/products/caliburn-g4-pro-koko) is the box-shaped one, with a bigger 2000mAh battery, about 93g, and five blind-draw screen themes.
Pick the shape you like.

en.heading: How is the G4 Pro different from the G4?
paragraphs: The [G4](/products/caliburn-g4) has a 0.85-inch colour screen, one button to run it and two modes.
The G4 Pro runs on a touchscreen, adds the Custom mode and has a bigger battery.

zh.heading: G4 Pro 还是 G4 Pro KOKO？
paragraphs: 两款都有触屏、最高 35W，都用 GPP 烟弹。
G4 Pro 是纤长款，屏幕更大，2.51 英寸，约 78g。
[G4 Pro KOKO](/products/caliburn-g4-pro-koko) 是方盒款，电池更大，2000mAh，约 93g，还有 5 款盲抽屏幕主题。
喜欢哪种造型就选哪款。

zh.heading: G4 Pro 和 G4 有什么不同？
paragraphs: [G4](/products/caliburn-g4) 是 0.85 英寸彩屏，一个按键操作，有两种模式。
G4 Pro 用触屏操作，多了 Custom 模式，电池也更大。

lede.en: The G4 Pro KOKO is a box-shaped device run from a touchscreen, with screen themes to collect.
lede.zh: G4 Pro KOKO 是方盒机身，用触屏操作，还有屏幕主题可以收集。

subline.en: You don't know which one you get until it opens.
subline.zh: 打开之前，不知道会抽到哪款。

body.en: The themes come from UWELL's blind-draw card game — collecting them is fun of its own.
body.zh: 主题来自 UWELL 的盲抽卡牌游戏，收集本身就是一种乐趣。

text.zh: 5 款屏幕主题

subline.en: The first KOKO with a touchscreen.

body.en: UWELL built this screen for vapers: an uncluttered screen, no menus to dig through.
body.zh: UWELL 专为烟友打造这块屏幕：界面简洁，不用层层找菜单。

text.zh: 触控准确率 99.99% 以上（UWELL 实验室数据）
响应时间不到 0.2 秒（UWELL 实验室数据）

body.en: Minimal bezels and an ergonomic curve that sits snugly in the hand.
body.zh: 窄边框加人体工学曲线，握在手里很贴合。

text.zh: 约 93g

body.en: One full charge lasts up to 10 days (UWELL lab tests).
body.zh: 充满一次最长可用 10 天（UWELL 实验室数据）。

text.zh: USB-C 充电，5V/2.5A

subline.en: From inside jokes to iconic names.
subline.zh: 从小梗到经典名字都行。

body.en: Switch on Clean UI and type the name on the screen; the other settings sit in the same menu.
body.zh: 开启 Clean UI，直接在屏幕上输入名字；其他设置也在同一菜单里。

text.zh: 8 种语言（不含泰语）
亮度与息屏时间

text.en: Animation, battery saver and system reset
text.zh: 动画、省电模式与系统重置

body.en: Storm for an instant throat hit, Waves for a smooth, steady taste, Customize set the way you like.
body.zh: Storm 即时击喉，Waves 口感顺滑稳定，Customize 按你喜欢的来设定。

text.en: Set the power at the start, middle and end of each puff
text.zh: 每一口的开头、中段、结尾都能设定功率

title.zh: 兼容所有 GPP 烟弹

body.en: The upgraded pods fit the G3 series too, and you refill without taking the pod out.
body.zh: 升级款烟弹也适用于 G3 系列，注油无需取下烟弹。

text.en: Top- and side-refill pods from 0.4Ω to 1.2Ω
text.zh: 顶部与侧边注油烟弹，0.4Ω 至 1.2Ω
U² 防漏
贴合唇形的烟嘴
